title: Norn armor
wikitext:

==Notes==
*Norn armor is a [[prestige armor]] art; therefore, it can be displayed in The [[Hall of Monuments]].

==Trivia==
During the [[Guild Wars Eye of the North Sneak Peek Weekend|preview weekend]], the Norn armor could only be crafted after reaching rank 7, Slayer of Heroes in the [[Norn rank]] title track.
